builder_lesson: When a small frozen probe can fit its train examples but held-out accuracy stalls or degrades, do not immediately unfreeze the large backbone. Treat sparse supervision as the first repair target. Add a bounded batch of varied examples only for observed failure competencies, keep the backbone frozen, and measure the previous probe on the expanded dev set before retraining so the repair has a fair baseline.
next_experiment: old frozen head on expanded dev -> fresh frozen head on expanded train -> same expanded dev -> inspect remaining failures
